en: A black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a view of a small town nestled in a hilly landscape, with a mix of residential buildings and larger urban structures. In the foreground, there is an impressive building with large windows, while the middle ground is dominated by densely packed houses and the background shows lush, wooded hills. The text at the bottom reads 'Glashütte i. Sa.' on the left and 'Bahnhofsviertel.' on the right.
